convention_statement: s_str is indexed by LOGICAL QUBIT: s_str[i] = planted bit on logical system qubit i (i=0..n-1, left to right). s_bits_msb_last = s_str[::-1] = same bits in qiskit measurement-register order (register position 0 = highest-index bit). BUILDER embeds s_str[i] on logical qubit i; DECODER reports s_hat in s_str (logical-qubit) order and HD is computed against s_str directly. Commitment = sha256((s_str+salt).encode()).
public_file_contents: HASHES + convention statement ONLY — s_str/s_bits_msb_last/salt WITHHELD (in private builder payload); reveals held in Ember court until Whisper posts s_hat.
